title: Driver shot dead by roadside in Buluan, Maguindanao del Sur
summary: A 45-year-old driver was shot dead by an unidentified gunman while standing at the roadside in Sitio Mahad, Barangay Poblacion, Buluan, Maguindanao del Sur, at about 2 pm on Sunday, 18 October 2026. The gunman fled; police found no spent shells and launched hot pursuit, dragnet and checkpoint operations.

sources.title: Lalaki patay sa pamamaril sa Buluan, Maguindanao del Sur

title: Coast Guard seaman killed, another wounded as gunmen fire on PCG vehicle in Cotabato City
summary: A Philippine Coast Guard seaman was killed and an apprentice seaman was wounded when two masked gunmen on a motorcycle fired into both sides of the vehicle carrying them and their station commander along Roman Vilo Street, Poblacion 6, Cotabato City, at noon on Thursday, 22 October 2026. Both were hit in the head; the seaman was declared dead on arrival at the Cotabato Regional and Medical Center. The commander was unhurt. Police recovered seven spent shells believed to be from a 9mm pistol; the gunmen fled toward the Texing and Washington area.

sources.title: UPDATE: Isa patay, isa sugatan sa pamamaril sa tatlong mga Coast Guard personnel sa Cotabato City

title: Three shot dead, two wounded at a fishpond on Timako Hill, Kalanganan 2, Cotabato City
summary: Three men were killed and two wounded when gunmen opened fire at Maceda Fishpond on Timako Hill, Barangay Kalanganan 2, Cotabato City, at 7:40 am on Friday, 23 October 2026. Police said the victims had arranged to meet five men posing as buyers of their produce; three of them stepped out of a white Toyota Hilux and fired long firearms. The dead were a 53-year-old businessman, a resident of Lebak, Sultan Kudarat, and a fisherman from Timako; the two wounded, among them a 49-year-old fisherman, were taken to the Cotabato Regional and Medical Center. Police are looking into a long-running family feud and extortion of the business, and are gathering CCTV footage to identify the gunmen and their vehicle. An early report said one of the dead was a former barangay kagawad.

sources.title: BREAKING NEWS | Tatlo nasawi, dalawa sugatan sa pamamaril sa Kalanganan 2

title: Four shot dead as gunmen riddle a silver car in Tulunan, Datu Anggal Midtimbang
summary: Four people riding in a silver car were killed when gunmen sprayed the vehicle with bullets on the afternoon of Monday, 26 October 2026, in Barangay Tulunan, Datu Anggal Midtimbang, Maguindanao del Sur. Col. Michael John Mangahis, the Maguindanao del Sur police provincial director, confirmed the four deaths to Radyo Bida and said the victims were not from Datu Anggal Midtimbang. They had not yet been identified.
